cause: The initial announcements used b.digest(JSON-string), which hashes its canonical JSON string representation, and incorrectly called this the SHA256 of file bytes. No frozen file was edited after its announcement.
questionAndCardHashes: originalSHA256/proposedSHA256 are b.digest(object), the canonical-object digest required by the manifest tool; unaffected.
futureAnnouncements: SHA256 of raw file bytes using crypto.createHash('sha256').update(Buffer).digest('hex'). Canonical-object digests retain the explicit canonical-object name.
